rows.reason: SS331/332 SSC063/199/200: this individual local JDBC allocation enters its protected try before any executable action; only the listed initializer-free local declaration may intervene. A nullable resource is checked inside protection; its own finally closes it once, capturing the actual primary and using JdbcResourceFailures only for the approved SQL/unknown precedence. No borrowed Connection close/config/commit/rollback or resource return occurs. The parser facts, actual compile/Jar bytes and independent current owner Tests (normal/null/projection/SQL/unknown/fatal/combined close/rollback/concurrency) refute this leak warning. Initializer/callback gaps, another binding or a missing guard fail validation. This is not evidence of live DB/lock/Root termination; Expiry plain-finally scopes are expressly excluded and remain BUG1530/SSC310 open.
